permissions.locationTitle: TerraWars uses your location while you walk
permissions.locationBody: While a walk is recording, TerraWars collects your precise location — including when your screen is off or you switch to another app — to draw your route and work out the territory you enclose. Your route is sent to our servers to check the claim. Other players never see your route or your live position, only the finished territory.
permissions.locationBullet1: Only while a walk is recording — never at any other time
permissions.locationBullet2: Never shown to other players, never sold, never used for ads
permissions.locationBullet3: Raw location points are deleted after 30 days
permissions.locationDenied: Without location access we can't record a walk. You can turn it on in Settings.
permissions.locationApproximate: TerraWars only has your approximate location. A walk needs precise location to trace your route — allow it here, or switch on "Precise location" in Settings.
permissions.locationUnavailable: Location isn't available on this device right now.
permissions.notificationsBody: We'll let you know when another player takes some of your land, so you can go and take it back.

safety.title: Walk safely
safety.body: TerraWars sends you outside. A few rules keep that fun:
safety.roadTitle: Watch the road, not your phone
safety.roadBody: The walk records on its own with the screen off. Look up at crossings, and never walk into traffic to finish a loop.
safety.placesTitle: Stay where you're allowed to be
safety.placesBody: Don't enter private property, closed areas or anywhere that feels unsafe. No territory is worth it.
safety.homeTitle: Don't start at your front door
safety.homeBody: Territory is public. A loop that starts and ends at home makes your home a corner of it — start a street away instead.

battery.title: Keep your walk running
battery.body: Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which can cut a walk short while your screen is off. Letting TerraWars run without restrictions keeps the whole route recording.

steps.xiaomi: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → TerraWars → Battery saver → No restrictions. Then open Security → Autostart and turn TerraWars on.
steps.oppo: Settings → Battery → App battery management (or More settings) → TerraWars → allow background activity and turn off "Optimise battery use".
steps.vivo: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → TerraWars → Allow high background power consumption.
steps.samsung: Settings → Apps → TerraWars → Battery → Unrestricted. Also check Battery → Background usage limits and make sure TerraWars isn't in "Sleeping apps".
steps.huawei: Settings → Battery → App launch → TerraWars → switch to Manage manually and allow all three options.
steps.transsion: Settings → Battery (or Power Marathon) → App power saving → TerraWars → No restrictions. Also allow TerraWars in Auto-start management.
steps.other: Settings → Apps → TerraWars → Battery → Unrestricted (or "Don't optimise").
